outcome: Short-term postoperative complications (major and minor) after myomectomy
cohort: The study included 27,387 patients who underwent abdominal or laparoscopic (conventional or robotic-assisted) myomectomy between 2012 and 2020 from the American College of Surgeons National Surgical Quality Improvement Program database.
finding: Patients with class 2 or 3 obesity are at increased odds of experiencing complications after myomectomy, whereas those with a slightly elevated BMI (class 1 obesity) may experience a protective effect, with complications related to BMI predominantly manifesting after abdominal myomectomy procedures.
